summary: DDC Enterprise Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a September 2, 2026 press release announcing 1H 2026 financial results. The board authorized an 18-month share repurchase program of up to US$10 million or 20% of outstanding Class A ordinary shares, whichever is lower. No specific price per share or premium was stated. The company held 2,899 BTC, up from 1,181, and repaid loans pledged by digital assets. The buyback is subject to market conditions and board discretion, with no expiration beyond the 18-month term. Watch for actual repurchase execution timing and potential price support.
